name: Yisilan Mala Pot - Bedok Road
description:
Yisilan Mala Restaurant is now open in Singapore with two outlets in Jalan Kayu and Bedok. Specialising in halal-certified mala hotpot and mala-inspired dishes, Yisilan was founded with one goal in mind: to bring the bold, numbing flavours of authentic Chinese mala cuisine to everyone, regardless of dietary background.

Guests can build their own mala hotpot by choosing their ingredients and customising their spice level — from mild to extra spicy — making it a welcoming experience for first-timers and mala lovers alike. (Mar 2026)
